description: This file defines custom exception classes related to Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically for cases where data is unavailable or the message cache is full.

classes.name: DataNotAvailableException
classes.description: An exception indicating that requested data is not available.

classes.name: CacheFullException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the queue message cache has reached its capacity.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException()
methods.description: Default constructor with message 'Data not found'.

methods.name: DataNotAvailableException(string message, Exception inner)
methods.description: Constructor with custom message and inner exception.

methods.name: CacheFullException()
methods.description: Default constructor with message 'Queue message cache is full'.

methods.name: CacheFullException(string message, Exception inner)
methods.description: Constructor with custom message and inner exception.
